req.title: Return PUT request metadata
req.statement: The system shall respond to PUT /put with JSON including url, args, headers, form, data, files, json and origin.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that PUT /put returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing exactly the keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, and origin. Tests are designed to: (1) verify the positive path with a JSON body payload, (2) verify form-encoded data, (3) verify query string args reflection, (4) verify the negative path using a wrong HTTP method (GET on /put), (5) verify boundary with an empty PUT body, and (6) verify that the json field is null when non-JSON content-type is sent. Each test asserts exact values to maximize mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_put_with_form_data_reflects_form_field
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: form field contains the submitted form key-value pair exactly
tests.executable:
import json as _json
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_put_with_form_data_reflects_form_field():
    r = client.put(
        '/put',
        data={'field1': 'hello', 'field2': 'world'},
        content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = _json.loads(r.data)
    assert body['form'] == {'field1': 'hello', 'field2': 'world'}
    assert body['json'] is None
    assert body['data'] == ''
    assert 'url' in body
    assert 'origin' in body
    assert 'headers' in body

test_put_with_form_data_reflects_form_field()

tests.name: test_put_with_query_string_reflects_args
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: url field contains the query string
tests.executable:
import json as _json
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_put_with_query_string_reflects_args():
    r = client.put('/put?foo=bar&baz=qux')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = _json.loads(r.data)
    assert body['args'] == {'foo': 'bar', 'baz': 'qux'}
    assert 'foo=bar' in body['url'] or 'baz=qux' in body['url']
    assert body['form'] == {}
    assert body['json'] is None

test_put_with_query_string_reflects_args()

tests.name: test_put_with_empty_body_returns_200_and_null_json
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send PUT /put with no body and no content-type
expected: json field is null (None) — empty body cannot be parsed as JSON
trace: get_dict: json.loads of empty bytes raises ValueError -> _json = None
tests.executable:
import json as _json
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_put_with_empty_body_returns_200_and_null_json():
    r = client.put('/put')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = _json.loads(r.data)
    required_keys = {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'form', 'data', 'files', 'json', 'origin'}
    assert set(body.keys()) >= required_keys
    assert body['json'] is None
    assert body['data'] == ''
    assert body['form'] == {}
    assert body['args'] == {}

test_put_with_empty_body_returns_200_and_null_json()

tests.name: test_put_response_url_field_contains_put_path
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send PUT /put with a JSON body
Inspect the url field in the response
expected: url field is a string ending with /put
url field is not empty string
tests.executable:
import json as _json
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_put_response_url_field_contains_put_path():
    r = client.put(
        '/put',
        data=_json.dumps({"a": 1}),
        content_type='application/json'
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = _json.loads(r.data)
    assert body['url'] is not None
    assert isinstance(body['url'], str)
    assert body['url'] != ''
    assert body['url'].endswith('/put')

test_put_response_url_field_contains_put_path()

tests.name: test_put_headers_field_reflects_sent_custom_header
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send PUT /put with a custom header X-Test-Header: sentinel-value
Parse response JSON and inspect headers field
expected: headers field contains X-Test-Header with value sentinel-value
headers field is a dict (not None, not empty)
tests.executable:
import json as _json
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_put_headers_field_reflects_sent_custom_header():
    r = client.put(
        '/put',
        headers={'X-Test-Header': 'sentinel-value'}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = _json.loads(r.data)
    assert isinstance(body['headers'], dict)
    assert len(body['headers']) > 0
    headers_lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in body['headers'].items()}
    assert headers_lower.get('x-test-header') == 'sentinel-value'

test_put_headers_field_reflects_sent_custom_header()

tests.name: test_put_non_json_content_type_sets_json_field_null
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send PUT /put with Content-Type: text/plain and a plain text body
expected: json field is null (None) — plain text is not valid JSON
data field equals the sent plain text string
trace: R-HTTPBIN-006: json field null when body is not JSON
get_dict: json.loads fails on plain text -> _json = None
tests.executable:
import json as _json
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_put_non_json_content_type_sets_json_field_null():
    r = client.put(
        '/put',
        data='plain text body',
        content_type='text/plain'
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = _json.loads(r.data)
    assert body['json'] is None
    assert body['data'] == 'plain text body'
    assert body['form'] == {}

test_put_non_json_content_type_sets_json_field_null()
